name: Dotyali
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.source_named: Glottolog refs are sociolinguistic surveys (Eichentopf 2014; Sapkota 2013) and a deixis paper; no phonology/grammar with a stress statement located

sources.citation: Bist, Nar Bahadur & Nirajan Bohara. 2026. An Action Research Study on the Pronunciation Challenges Faced by Doteli Students. International Research Journal of MMC 7(3): 28-37. doi:10.3126/irjmmc.v7i3.97068
sources.note: Generic remarks on L1 rhythm/stress influence on English (citing Wenk 1985 etc.); nothing specific about Doteli stress.

sources.citation: Thapa, Tej Bahadur. 2021. Place and Time Deixis in Doteli Language. MA thesis, Department of English Education, Tribhuvan University, Kirtipur. xiv+53 pp.https://elibrary.tucl.edu.np/handle/20.500.14540/10092
sources.access_detail: a digital copy (available on request); access check: not located online or in the libraries checked
sources.note: Deixis only; the words 'stress', 'accent', 'tone' do not occur in a linguistic sense (a full-text search for stress/accent the full text).

sources.citation: Bist, Nar Bahadur. 2026. Improving English Pronunciation Among Doteli-Speaking Students. The EFFORTS, Journal of Education and Research 7(1): 130-149. doi:10.3126/ejer.v7i1.96785
sources.note: Pedagogical action research; says only that 'Doteli-speaking learners have difficulty in producing several English consonants, vowels, consonant clusters, stress patterns and final consonants' (p. 132); no description of Doteli stress itself.

sources.citation: Wikipedia (English). 'Doteli language', section Phonology (accessed 2026-09-17)
sources.note: Vowel and consonant inventories only; no statement on stress, tone or accent; cites only Ethnologue, the Language Commission report, the constitution, Eichentopf 2014 and ISO 639-3.

sources.citation: Bhatt, Hari Sharan. 2023. Digital Implementation of Doteli Dictionary: A Tri-Lingual Dictionary for Doteli Language. Scholars' Journal 6: 33-48. doi:10.3126/scholars.v6i1.69993
sources.note: Software paper; useful only for its reference to Joshi, B. et al. 2022, Dotyali multilingual dictionary (Mahakali Sahitya Sangam). Nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Singh, Karishma. 2023. Grammatical Category of Nepali and Doteli Language. Academia Research Journal 2(1). doi:10.3126/academia.v2i1.52352
sources.note: Nepali-language comparison of gender, number, person, tense, aspect, mood, voice, case; nothing on stress.

sources.citation: जोशी, धनकुमारी (Joshi, Dhankumari). 2018 (VS 2074). डोटेली भाषिकामा प्रचलित क्रियापदको अध्ययन [Study of the verbs current in the Doteli dialect]. MA thesis, Central Department of Nepali, Tribhuvan University.https://elibrary.tucl.edu.np/handle/20.500.14540/20182
sources.note: Verb morphology only (finite/non-finite verbs, tense, aspect); a short 'Doteli dialect' introduction (3.4); nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Eichentopf, Stephanie R. 2014. A Sociolinguistic Study of Dotyali. Kathmandu: LinSuN / SIL International (SIL Electronic Survey Report), 161 pp.
sources.note: Glottolog's main reference; contains transcribed wordlists for several Dotyali varieties that might mark stress, and is the source Wikipedia and Ethnologue rely on. Blocked by an automated-access block here; opens in a normal browser.

sources.citation: बोगटी, नरेन्द्र बहादुर (Bogati, Narendra Bahadur). 2013 (VS 2070). डोटेली भाषाको अध्ययन [Doteli bhashako adhyayan, 'A study of the Doteli language']. MA thesis, Department of Nepali Language Education, Tribhuvan University, Kirtipur. 75 pp. + appendix.https://elibrary.tucl.edu.np/handle/20.500.14540/14339
sources.note: Ch. 4.1 'डोटेली भाषामा उच्चारण व्यवस्था' (pp. 28-35) treats only vowel, diphthong and consonant pronunciation (tables 1-3) and processes such as assimilation, deaspiration, vowel epenthesis/deletion; section 2.3.4 lists 30-odd morphological/phonological 'features'. No mention of stress, accent, बलाघात, स्वराघात, अनुतान or syllable prominence anywhere (searched the whole text after Preeti-to-Unicode conversion).

sources.citation: Grierson, George A. (ed.). 1916. Linguistic Survey of India, vol. IX part IV: Pahari languages and Gujuri. Calcutta. (Kumauni/Eastern Pahari specimens; Doti area)
sources.note: Older comparative treatment of the Kumauni-Nepali borderland dialects to which Doteli belongs; dsal.uchicago.edu serves page scan (JavaScript BookReader, no text), so whether it says anything on accent for the Doti dialect was not checked.

sources.citation: भट्ट, नारायणी (Bhatta, Narayani). 2024. डोट्याली भाषामा वर्णभेद [Phonemic distinctions in the Dotyali language]. Sudurpaschim Spectrum (Far Western University, Mahendranagar) 2(1): 224-244. doi:10.3126/sudurpaschim.v2i1.69508

tone.quote: [p. 233] खणडेतर वर्णाअन्तर्गत दीर्घता, बल, सुर, लय अादि पर्दछन् । [...] [p. 245] डाेट्याली भाषााका खणडेतर वर्णाहरू — डाेट्याली भाषाामा खणडीय वर्णाका साथै खणडेतर वर्णाहरू पनि रहेका छन् । यस भाषाामा अनुनासिकता र दीर्घताले शब्दकाे अर्थमा भेद ल्याएकाे पाइएकाेले ती डाेट्याली भाषााका खणडेतर वर्णा हुन् । [...] डाेट्याली भाषााका सबै स्वरका ह्रस्व र दीर्घ रूप रहेका पाइन्छन् र ती व्यतिरेकी वितरणामा अाउँछन्
tone.locator: p. 233, introduction to phoneme theory; p. 245, section 'डोट्याली भाषाका खण्डेतर वर्णहरू' (suprasegmental phonemes of Dotyali). Quote is; spurious doubled matras (भाषाा, वर्णा, खणड for खण्ड) are conversion artefacts, wording unaltered.
tone.translation: [p. 233] Under suprasegmental phonemes fall length, stress, pitch (tone), rhythm and so on. [...] [p. 245] The suprasegmental phonemes of Dotyali — In Dotyali, alongside the segmental phonemes there are also suprasegmental phonemes. Since in this language nasalization and length have been found to bring about differences in word meaning, these are the suprasegmental phonemes of Dotyali. [...] All vowels of Dotyali are found to have short and long forms, and these occur in contrastive distribution.
tone.n_tones: None: distinctive suprasegmentals enumerated are nasalization and vowel length…

sources.citation: जोशी, खगेन्द्र (Joshi, Khagendra). 2023. डोट्याली भाषाको वर्णव्यवस्था [Alphabet of Dotali language = The phoneme system of Dotyali]. Sudurpaschim Spectrum (Far Western University, Mahendranagar) 1(1): 230-246. doi:10.3126/sudurpaschim.v1i1.63470

tone.summary: Says nothing about tone; a trial orthography guide: 6 vowels (from minimal pairs), 30 consonants, nasalization marks, short vs long vowels (long written with ः), spelling rules, sample texts.
